turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric, so I can't give a median number of days from signup to first order. The closest metrics are signup_to_first_order_rate (the share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up, counted on the signup day), signups, and customers_distinct (active customers).
